timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1500–1530 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is at a 28-year weakest level, with the exchange rate now at 1500+ won per dollar—the highest since the IMF crisis. Multiple sources confirm this is a "new normal" with the rate expected to hover around 1530 won in the near term, meaning your KRW converts to fewer dollars than it would at a stronger won level.

TIP: Consider dollar-cost averaging or waiting for news of semiconductor strength or a won-strengthening catalyst, as several sources hint that authorities and global banks expect the rate to eventually fall, potentially making future conversions cheaper.
